title: Applied AI Architect, Technology Partnerships
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI Architect on the Technology Partnerships team at Anthropic, you will be the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building unique product integrations with Claude. These are software companies whose platforms are systems of record for their customers, and who want those customers to be able to work with their data and workflows directly inside Claude. This role goes deep with each partner. You will own the technical side of product partnerships from first scoping through launch and beyond. You will help partners design how their platform shows up in Claude (MCP servers, connectors, plugins, and skills), hold the quality bar through evaluations, and act as the bridge between the partner's product and engineering teams and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. You will be a trusted technical advisor to partner engineering leaders and executives, and you will turn what you learn into patterns and playbooks that make every future integration faster and better. Responsibilities Technical ownership of strategic integrations: Serve as the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building product integrations with Claude. Own the technical plan from use-case definition and scoping through build, launch, and post-launch iteration. Integration architecture: Advise partners on how to expose their platform to Claude, including MCP server design, tool and API surface design for large platforms, authentication and admin onboarding, permissions, and plugin and skill structure. Be opinionated about the patterns that lead to the best experience for joint customers. Evaluations and quality: Design and run evaluations of partner integrations against the use cases that matter most to joint customers. Turn results into concrete, prioritized feedback for partner engineering teams and hold a high quality bar before launch. Hands-on prototyping: Build prototypes, demos, and reference skills that show partners the art of the possible, accelerate their build, and contribute to product improvements. Launch readiness: Partner with Product, Partnerships, Marketing, and GTM teams to get integrations launch-ready on partner-driven timelines such as customer conferences and product events, and support partners and early customers through launch. Product and research feedback loop: Act as the connective tissue between partners and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. Surface integration gaps and platform requirements, help shape the roadmap for how Claude works with third-party software, and bring early capabilities to partners. Executive technical relationships: Build trusted relationships with partner CTOs, product leaders, and engineering leads. Explain technical tradeoffs and Anthropic's point of view clearly to technical and executive audiences alike. Scale what works: Codify reference architectures, integration best practices, evaluation approaches, self-serve guidance, and playbooks so each new technology partnership starts from a stronger foundation, and help enable account teams and the broader partner ecosystem. Joint customer success: Support account teams on strategic joint customers adopting partner integrations, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. You may be a good fit if you have 8+ years of experience in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Engineer, Developer Relations Engineer, or Technical Account Manager, or as a software engineer on platform, API, or integrations work A track record of leading complex technical integrations with ISVs or technology partners, from solution design through launch Deep experience with APIs, platform integration, and enterprise SaaS architecture, including authentication and authorization models, permissions, and admin experience Hands-on familiarity with LLM applications and agentic tooling, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use, agents, and evaluation frameworks Strong coding ability; you can build prototypes, write evals, and work in a real codebase (comfort with Python or TypeScript expected) Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering leaders Product sense, and the judgment to know when to push a partner toward a better design and when to adapt to their constraints Comfort operating in early-stage, ambiguous environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet, and a track record of building structure as you go Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
